title: Every train in the GTA in 24 hours
description:
Every train running in the GTA on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside Toronto, Peel Region, York Region, Durham Region and Halton Region. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: Line 1, Line 2, GO, Line 5, Line 6, Line 4 and UP.

Busiest moment: 187 trains at 8:12 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Thanksgiving (October 12).
